{{Top|leg}}
'''Shamblers''' were a spawn of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]]. They were created by [[Sorzus Syn]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred Year Darkness]]. Lessons learned in the creation of Shamblers, [[Howler (Yavin 4)|Howlers]], and [[Pit Horror]] lead to the creation of [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]].<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
